title: E. coli Optical Quantification
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xu3fnyn

steps.title: Prepare culture broth
steps.instruction: Pipette 10 mL BHI broth into a 15 mL centrifuge tube, place the tube in an incubator or water bath to warm, add 2 mg lyophilized E. coli K-12, close the lid, shake gently, and incubate at 37 °C for several hours.

steps.title: Prepare blank cuvette
steps.instruction: Dispense 1 mL of the warmed BHI broth (without bacteria) into a cuvette, wipe the cuvette with delicate task wipes if necessary, insert it carefully into the spectrometer, and measure the intensity at 600 nm to obtain the reference I₀.

steps.title: Measure sample absorbance
steps.instruction: At each desired culture time point, withdraw 1 mL of the culture supernatant (avoid any precipitate), place it in a clean cuvette, insert the cuvette into the spectrometer, and record the intensity at 600 nm.

steps.title: Calculate absorbance
steps.instruction: Using the blank intensity I₀ as the reference, calculate the absorbance of each sample (A = -log10(I/I₀)).

steps.title: Plot results
steps.instruction: Plot absorbance versus culture time and include the plot together with the table of measured intensities and calculated absorbances in the Results section of the lab report.
